01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol colorblind-safe palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and a polished dual-representation (parallel coords + sparkline histogram table) elevate this well above generic, though 150 overlapping lines make the parallel coords too dense to extract individual stories and the 32px sparkline rows are cramped.
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.encoding_integrity_note: Parallel coords axes use data-driven d3.extent domains and zero-baseline sparkline histograms are correct, but bin thresholds are hardcoded at 24 (not Sturges'/Scott's rule) and fg-bars data join lacks a key function, making it brittle under reordering.
flags: Stale Scale (no resize handler — x/y scales computed once from clientWidth, stale after viewport change)
drawStrums un-throttled — direct SVG DOM mutation on every pointermove without RAF, though low-cost
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.stress_test_note: RAF coalescing correctly guards the expensive canvas+table redraw on brush/strum events, no transitions eliminate mid-flight race conditions, and pointer events with brush filter cleanly separate strumming from axis brushing, but scales are never recalculated on resize and strum line drawing bypasses the RAF queue.
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.cognitive_load_note: Two linked views (parallel coords + sparkline table) stay within working memory limits, the 6-color Paul Tol palette is distinguishable, and canvas opacity management (10% gray background / 50% colored foreground) handles 150-line density well — main friction is the non-obvious dual interaction model (brush vs. shift-strum) that isn't self-discoverable without reading the hint text.
